description: Instant and free: the latest finished standard search for one of the covered cities, about six weeks out, refreshed on a rota: whole homes for two adults and five nights in most cities, a six-adult weekend in New Orleans, Miami, Las Vegas, South Lake Tahoe, Sedona; stayType "hotel" gives the hotel-room trip (two adults, three nights) where one exists (Austin, Lisbon, Kyoto, Mexico City, New York, Paris, Barcelona, Montreal, San Diego, Edinburgh, Honolulu, London, Nashville, Scottsdale, New Orleans, Miami, Las Vegas, South Lake Tahoe, Sedona). Covered: Austin, Lisbon, Kyoto, Mexico City, New York, Paris, Barcelona, Montreal, San Diego, Edinburgh, Honolulu, London, Nashville, Scottsdale, New Orleans, Miami, Las Vegas, South Lake Tahoe, Sedona, Holbox, Niagara-on-the-Lake, Bentonville, Knoxville, Asheville, Canmore, Coeur d'Alene, Broken Bow, Lancaster, Ann Arbor, Da Nang, Hoi An. beachWeek gives the Beach Week Board instead: Playa del Carmen, Cancún, Punta Cana, one January week (2 adults, 5 nights from 2027-01-14) searched every Thursday, its picks grouped by area at stayotter.com/board. newYears gives the New Year's Eve board (a sneak peek): Nashville and Las Vegas, hotel rooms for 2 adults, 3 nights from 2026-12-30, each area measured to where the night happens, at stayotter.com/board/new-years. For other places or specific dates use search_stays.
